title: The Show-Up Attack: When Subagents Win Over Their Supervisor
abstract: arXiv:2610.27574v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Multi-agent systems are increasingly deployed to coordinate multiple large language model (LLM) agents. However, this also creates new attack surfaces: malicious agents may have chances to exploit the coordination. In this paper, we propose and study the \textit{show-up attack}, in which a malicious subagent manipulates the supervisor into involving it in tasks beyond its assigned scope. To evaluate this risk, we propose SUA-Arena, which implements 6 attack strategies and contains 188 test cases. Then, we evaluate 6 frontier LLMs and find that all of them are vulnerable to show-up attacks. For example, GPT-5.6-Sol as a supervisor suffers an ASR of up to 0.93. Mitigation strategies such as prompting and restricted communication fail to reduce the risk consistently. These results show that multi-agent systems need explicit mechanisms for enforcing authority boundaries.

translated_title: “登场攻击”：当子代理成功操纵其监督者时
translated_abstract: 多智能体系统正日益被部署用于协调多个大语言模型（LLM）智能体。然而，这也带来了新的攻击面：恶意智能体可能有机会利用这种协调机制。在本文中，我们提出并研究了“登场攻击”，即恶意子代理操纵监督者，使其将其纳入超出自身指派范围的任务之中。为评估这一风险，我们提出了SUA-Arena，它实现了6种攻击策略并包含188个测试用例。随后，我们评估了6个前沿大语言模型，发现它们全部易受登场攻击的影响。例如，GPT-5.6-Sol作为监督者时，攻击成功率（ASR）高达0.93。诸如提示词约束和受限通信等缓解策略无法持续降低风险。这些结果表明，多智能体系统需要明确的机制来执行权限边界。
tldr: 本文提出并研究了多智能体系统中的新型“登场攻击”——恶意子代理操纵监督者使其参与超出职责范围的任务，构建了包含6种攻击策略和188个测试用例的SUA-Arena评测基准，发现6个前沿大语言模型均易受攻击（如GPT-5.6-Sol作为监督者时攻击成功率高达0.93），且现有缓解策略效果不佳，表明多智能体系统亟需明确的权限边界执行机制。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes the "show-up attack," where a malicious subagent manipulates its supervisor in multi-agent systems to get involved in tasks beyond its assigned scope; the authors introduce SUA-Arena (6 attack strategies, 188 test cases) and show that all 6 frontier LLMs are vulnerable (ASR up to 0.93 for GPT-5.6-Sol as supervisor), revealing that multi-agent systems need explicit mechanisms to enforce authority boundaries.
